summary: Admissibility of CCTV footage without Section 65B certificate; witness testimony contradictions in eyewitness account; omission of test identification parade; Sharad Birdhichand Sarda principles for circumstantial evidence applied; evidence found unreliable; conviction against appellants set aside due to lack of cogent evidence.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.364, s.302, s.201, s.212, s.120-B
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.161, s.162
Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellants acquitted; High Court judgment reversed.
